claim: The built @byokit/endpoint refuses a subscription provider id as not a key route with a typed error, and starts the real pinned CLIProxyAPI v8.0.48 on loopback for one fixture API key: in a no-network namespace, with the explicit retry: 1 opt-in (retries are off by default), a client request returns 200 after one repeat, with one upstream identity, no leaked key file, no extra log file and no Claude Code look-alike call. No live provider, account or model is proven.

steps.start: A built checkout, the pinned CLIProxyAPI v8.0.48 release archive (checksum checked) and a loopback fake upstream; no account, key or model
steps: Ask the built kit to start an endpoint for a subscription provider id (claude) and read the typed unknown-provider refusal
Start the real pinned binary through startEndpoint with one fixture API key and the explicit retry: 1 opt-in, in a no-network namespace
Send one chat request with the per-run client key; the fake upstream fails the first call
Read the request outcome, the upstream call log, the leftover files and the Claude Code look-alike count
steps.result: The refusal names the requirement; the client got HTTP 200 after the one opted-in retry, with one upstream identity, no file holding the key, no extra log file and no look-alike call (pass line in drive.log)

verdicts.seen: I read all 3 content lines of summary.txt. These match the outcome's refusal, retry, single identity, and no-leak claims. The capture does not show the no-network namespace directly, but it is consistent with the drive log.
